ios.desc:
Get rid of annoying text spam.

Blacklist keywords from unwanted messages or just filter away everything you get from unknown senders. Add exceptions to the whitelist to avoid filtering useful service messages like activation codes or one time passwords.

SMS Spam Block is secure, all filtering is done on the device.

SMS Spam Block is FREE with no ads or in-app purchases.

quotes.text:
I’m using a free app called SMS block[0] for a number of years. Other than a weird app icon (has a strange logo that has the word TAXI on it with a cross mark for some odd reason), it seems to run local and does the job simply and effectively. Wonder if I need to worry about it leaking any data? I guess it’s easy to switch to Bouncer

[0] https://apps.apple.com/de/app/sms-spam-block/id1283355601?l=en

I’ve been using a similar app, though the one I use doesn’t support regular expressions. Not really sure why this isn’t built into iOS. When used with the right list of terms, the app works well.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sms-spam-block/id1283355601
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: How do I stop political SMS spam?

quotes.text: SMS Spam Block is a good free option if you just want to make a simple keyword list: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sms-spam-block/id1283355601
